{
  "dataset_name": "amazon_employee_access",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "resource_approval_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Training-set approval rate for the given RESOURCE value, encoded as a smoothed frequency ratio. High approval rate resources are more likely to be granted access.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "target_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous signal capturing how commonly a resource is approved, useful for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "RESOURCE.map(RESOURCE.value_counts(normalize=True)).fillna(0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_rollup1_frequency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized frequency of ROLE_ROLLUP_1 value in training set. Common role rollups may have different access patterns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "frequency_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures role hierarchy popularity as a smooth continuous feature for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "ROLE_ROLLUP_1.map(ROLE_ROLLUP_1.value_counts(normalize=True)).fillna(0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_rollup2_frequency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized frequency of ROLE_ROLLUP_2 value in training set. Captures sub-hierarchy role distribution.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "frequency_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth continuous encoding of role sub-hierarchy for linear margin computation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "ROLE_ROLLUP_2.map(ROLE_ROLLUP_2.value_counts(normalize=True)).fillna(0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_family_frequency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized frequency of ROLE_FAMILY in training set. Role families with higher frequency may have more standardized access.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "frequency_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes role family commonality as a continuous feature useful for SVM margin optimization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "ROLE_FAMILY.map(ROLE_FAMILY.value_counts(normalize=True)).fillna(0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_title_frequency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized frequency of ROLE_TITLE in training set. Common titles may have more predictable access patterns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "frequency_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous encoding of role title prevalence for linear decision boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "ROLE_TITLE.map(ROLE_TITLE.value_counts(normalize=True)).fillna(0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mgr_resource_diversity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed count of unique resources managed by the same MGR_ID, normalized by log of total unique resources. Captures manager scope breadth.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Managers overseeing many resources may have broader access authority; this continuous score aids linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(MGR_ID.map(MGR_ID.groupby(MGR_ID).transform('count').groupby(MGR_ID).first()).fillna(1.0)) / np.log1p(3807.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_hierarchy_consistency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of ROLE_ROLLUP_2 frequency to ROLE_ROLLUP_1 frequency, clipped to [0,1]. Measures how specific the sub-role is relative to its parent rollup.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures role hierarchy specificity as a smooth ratio feature useful for linear models to detect unusual role combinations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(ROLE_ROLLUP_2.map(ROLE_ROLLUP_2.value_counts(normalize=True)).fillna(0.0) / (ROLE_ROLLUP_1.map(ROLE_ROLLUP_1.value_counts(normalize=True)).fillna(0.0) + 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "resource_log_frequency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p-transformed raw count of RESOURCE occurrences in training set, normalized by log1p of max count. Captures resource popularity on log scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "frequency_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log-scaled resource frequency reduces skew and provides a smooth continuous feature for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(RESOURCE.map(RESOURCE.value_counts()).fillna(0.0)) / np.log1p(262.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_code_title_match",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator whether ROLE_CODE and ROLE_TITLE have the same frequency rank bucket (both in top 10 or both not). Detects alignment between code and title.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "consistency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Consistent role code-title pairing may indicate standard access patterns; binary feature adds interpretable dimension for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((ROLE_CODE.map(ROLE_CODE.value_counts()).fillna(0.0) > 200) == (ROLE_TITLE.map(ROLE_TITLE.value_counts()).fillna(0.0) > 200), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_family_desc_rarity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Inverse frequency of ROLE_FAMILY_DESC, log-scaled. Rare role family descriptions may indicate unusual access requests.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "rarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Rarity of role family description provides a continuous anomaly signal useful for SVM margin in detecting unusual access patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(1.0 - np.log1p(ROLE_FAMILY_DESC.map(ROLE_FAMILY_DESC.value_counts()).fillna(0.0)) / np.log1p(2099.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "role_specificity_composite",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how specific and narrow the employee role is based on the combination of ROLE_FAMILY, ROLE_TITLE, and ROLE_FAMILY_DESC cardinalities. Higher values indicate more specialized roles that may have restricted access patterns. Score from 0 (very generic role) to 1 (highly specialized role).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures role specialization as a continuous composite score, providing a smooth semantic feature for linear SVM margin optimization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "manager_role_alignment_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of alignment between the manager (MGR_ID) and the role hierarchy (ROLE_ROLLUP_1, ROLE_ROLLUP_2). Evaluates whether the manager-role combination appears organizationally coherent based on co-occurrence frequency patterns. Score from 0 (misaligned or rare combination) to 1 (well-aligned common combination).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Manager-role alignment provides a continuous organizational coherence signal that helps linear models identify structurally unusual access requests.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
